rules.expected: Structure identity, charge/spin and explicit frequency validation are present and internally consistent.
Calculation, alignment, peak selection and mode evidence are reproducibly documented.
normal mode 3 is identified as an in-plane bending mode or the report transparently disputes this with evidence.
Partial agreement and unassigned-band/model limitations are stated.
Final conclusion supports the prominent-feature FC interpretation, identifies mode 3/in-plane bending, and states limitations.
